title: TAC Weekly Report, Week 22
author: Greg
summary: Mall Scanner shipped a sale-alert cycle. Client portal validation accepted. Artifact manifest drift remained the blocker.

sections.heading: Wins
bullets: Mall Scanner cycle ran end to end; brand pages were diffed and sale alerts were dispatched.
Client Portal validation receipt written. Cognito group plus email allowlist verified.
UI Agent surface taxonomy now lists every public, gated, tenant, and dynamic route.
Apps registry promoted to status validated for client-portal-gbautomation.
Reusable client portal primitives extracted into src/clients/shared.

sections.heading: Blockers
bullets: public/artifacts/manifest.json lags the disk tree. /artifacts may show stale data.

sections.heading: Proof-gated metrics
bullets: Numeric rollups are omitted from the public portal until source-backed receipts are attached.

sections.heading: Next week
bullets: Reconcile artifacts manifest with disk tree.
Land the shared PageHeader and Layout primitives.
Start the second client tenant repo template.
